rationale: Seven blocking findings: one critical ImportError in alembic/env.py:90 that prevents all migrations (the change's central deliverable cannot run), three service-layer correctness bugs (touch_timestamp violation at line 387, NULL ids passed to get_by_ids at line 794, unconditional folder_deleted=True at line 871), one undocumented search_conversations behavior change that silently expands results from 20 to 60 and drops recency ordering, and two blocking code-quality standard violations in new code. Three pre-existing items deferred (empty migration downgrade by design, analytics filter inconsistency, move-folder count check); one false-positive dismissed (SQLModel scalar return from single-column select).

standards_review.notes: All 41 commit subjects in range follow the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format; two Jira tickets referenced (EPMCDME-13270, EPMCDME-15009, EPMCDME-15006) with colon-space separator throughout

guide requires X | None unions and list[T] parameterized generics instead of typing.Optional and typing.List; new file src/codemie/rest_api/models/assistant_folder.py:24 uses Optional[str] for icon_url; new endpoints in src/codemie/rest_api/routers/conversation.py annotate return types as List[AssistantFolderListItem]; other new code correctly uses list[str] and list[AssistantFolderListItem]; license headers present

both new endpoints use Depends(authenticate); no credentials logged; user input (assistant_id: str, remove_conversations: bool) is typed and bound via ORM parameters, no raw SQL from user-supplied strings; no lossy input normalization found

findings.title: Optional[str] annotation violates code-quality standard
findings.problem: icon_url is annotated Optional[str] instead of str | None; the file already has from __future__ import annotations making the modern union form safe
findings.impact: New source code uses the explicitly-deprecated annotation style the guide lists as a blocking Avoid; will trigger ruff rule UP007
findings.recommendation: Replace Optional[str] with str | None on line 25 and remove the typing.Optional import if it becomes unused

findings.title: List[T] annotations in new endpoint return types
findings.problem: get_assistant_folders (line 322) and its response_model decorator (line 320) both use typing.List[AssistantFolderListItem] instead of list[AssistantFolderListItem]
findings.impact: New code uses the explicitly-deprecated parameterized-generic form the guide lists as a blocking Avoid; will trigger ruff rule UP006
findings.recommendation: Replace List[AssistantFolderListItem] with list[AssistantFolderListItem] in the response_model decorator and function return annotation; remove List from the typing import if it becomes unused

findings.title: import_source write-once backfill bumps update_date
findings.problem: When import_source is set for the first time on an existing conversation (line 385–387), conversation.update() is called without touch_timestamp=False, using the default touch_timestamp=True
findings.impact: Bumps update_date on the first CLI sync of an existing chat, reordering the conversation in the sidebar and violating the explicit EPMCDME-15009 invariant that non-usage writes must not update timestamps
findings.recommendation: Change conversation.update() to conversation.update(touch_timestamp=False) on line 387, consistent with other non-usage writes in the same file

findings.title: get_assistant_folders passes NULL ids to Assistant.get_by_ids
findings.problem: select(Conversation.initial_assistant_id) at line 794 does not exclude NULL values; conversations where initial_assistant_id IS NULL contribute None to assistant_ids, which is then passed directly to Assistant.get_by_ids at line 812
findings.impact: None in the ids list may cause a DB query error or silently return unexpected rows; any user who has plain conversations (no initial_assistant_id set) will trigger this path on every GET /v1/assistant-folders call
findings.recommendation: Add .where(Conversation.initial_assistant_id.is_not(None)) to the select statement before .distinct()

findings.title: delete_assistant_folder returns folder_deleted=True when nothing deleted
findings.problem: folder_deleted=True is set unconditionally at line 873 in the return statement, even when conversation_ids is empty and the if conversation_ids: block (line 853) was skipped
findings.impact: Client receives deleted_conversation_ids=[] with folder_deleted=True — contradictory information causing incorrect UI state: the folder appears deleted when no row was actually removed (e.g. all conversations are pinned, imported, or in custom folders)
findings.recommendation: Set folder_deleted based on whether any conversations were found: folder_deleted=bool(conversation_business_ids)

findings.title: search_conversations ordering and result count silently changed
findings.problem: The method now returns type-ordered results (assistants first, then chats, then folders) with up to limit items per type, replacing the previous unified recency-sorted list capped at limit total; SearchResultItem.updated_at is Optional[datetime] and None for assistants, so they always appear first regardless of recency
findings.impact: Clients expecting a recency-sorted 20-item list silently receive up to 60 items in type-grouped order; the API contract change is not versioned and no documentation update accompanies it
findings.recommendation: Either restore the combined recency sort and single cap to preserve existing client behavior, or introduce an API version bump and document the new per-type response contract explicitly

findings.title: ImportError in alembic env.py blocks all migrations
findings.problem: env.py:90 contains `from codemie.rest_api.models.assistant_folder import AssistantFolder`, but the rewritten assistant_folder.py defines only AssistantFolderListItem and AssistantFolderDeleteResponse; no AssistantFolder class exists in that module
findings.impact: Every alembic upgrade, downgrade, and autogenerate command fails with ImportError before any migration logic runs; the central deliverable of this change (w2x3y4z5a6b7_drop_assistant_folders) cannot be applied to any environment
findings.recommendation: Remove line 90 from src/external/alembic/env.py — the ORM class is gone and the table is dropped by migration w2x3y4z5a6b7, not by SQLAlchemy metadata autogenerate
